floater.name: fs_camera_bookmarks
floater.title: Camera Bookmarks
floater.string: [TOUR]: stop [NUMBER] of [COUNT], [NAME] ([SKIPPED] out of reach, skipped)

button.name: compact_toggle
button.label: Compact
button.tool_tip: Compact mode only keeps the bookmark list.

button.name: tours_toggle
button.label: << Tours
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the tours panel.

scroll_list.name: bookmarks
scroll_list.tool_tip: Double-click to go to the view; a view in another region offers a teleport first, and a view following something follows it. Right-click for more. Select several with Ctrl or Shift to copy, delete or add them to a tour together.

button.name: add_following
button.label: Add View Following Target
button.tool_tip: Save the current view kept relative to what the camera is on: the object or avatar you alt-clicked, else the selected object, else your avatar.

check_box.name: follow_turns
check_box.label: Turn with it
check_box.tool_tip: The camera also turns relative to the moving target. Unticked, the camera keeps its own direction and only moves along.

button.name: add
button.label: Add Current View
button.tool_tip: Save the current camera view under a name, with its field of view and roll

button.name: paste
button.label: Paste Links
button.tool_tip: Add the camera links in the clipboard.

button.name: go
button.label: Go
button.tool_tip: Move the camera to the selected view, teleporting first if it is in another region

button.name: copy
button.label: Copy Link
button.tool_tip: Copy the selected view's camera link, to paste in chat or a notecard. Several selected are copied as 'name: link' lines.

button.name: update_view
button.label: Set to Current View
button.tool_tip: Replace the selected bookmark's view with the current camera view.

button.name: move_up
button.label: Up
button.tool_tip: Move the selected bookmark up

button.name: move_down
button.label: Down
button.tool_tip: Move the selected bookmark down

combo_box.name: tour_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: The tour to edit and play

button.name: new_tour
button.label: New
button.tool_tip: Start a new, empty tour

scroll_list.name: stops
scroll_list.tool_tip: The tour's bookmarks. Select one or several to change their timing and camera move below. Double-click to go to a bookmark.

scroll_list.columns.name: fly
scroll_list.columns.label: Fly s
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Seconds flying here from the stop before

scroll_list.columns.name: move
scroll_list.columns.label: Camera move
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: What the camera does while it holds here

button.name: add_stops
button.label: Add Bookmarks
button.tool_tip: Add the bookmarks selected on the left to the end of this tour, in order (a new tour is made if there is none).

button.name: add_current_stop
button.label: Add Current View
button.tool_tip: Add the current camera view to the end of this tour, without saving it as a bookmark

button.name: remove_stops
button.label: Remove
button.tool_tip: Remove the selected stop from this tour.

button.name: stop_up
button.label: Up
button.tool_tip: Move the selected stop up

button.name: stop_down
button.label: Down
button.tool_tip: Move the selected stop down

spinner.name: stop_travel
spinner.label: Fly s
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds the camera takes to fly to this stop from the one before

spinner.name: stop_hold
spinner.label: Hold s
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds the camera stays at this stop, moving as set below

combo_box.name: stop_ease
combo_box.tool_tip: How the camera speeds up and slows down flying here. Smooth starts and arrives slowly; linear keeps a steady speed, for one continuous shot through stops that don't hold; ease in starts slowly; ease out arrives slowly.

combo_box.name: stop_move
combo_box.tool_tip: Movement style of the camera while held in place. Orbit circles around the point it looks at; pan turns the camera in place; push in and pull out move towards or away from that point; rise and sink move straight up or down.

spinner.name: stop_amount
spinner.tool_tip: How far the camera moves over the hold: degrees for orbit and pan, a percent of the distance for push in and pull out, meters for rise and sink

combo_box.name: tour_repeat
combo_box.tool_tip: After the last stop: stay there, start over at the first, or come back through the stops and go round again

combo_box.name: tour_path
combo_box.tool_tip: Straight flies in a line from stop to stop; curved sweeps through the stops on a smooth curve, for one flowing shot (with linear stops that don't hold)

check_box.name: tour_hide_ui
check_box.label: Hide UI
check_box.tool_tip: Hide the interface while the tour plays. ESC ends the tour and brings the interface back.

button.name: play_tour
button.label: Play
button.tool_tip: Fly the camera through the stops in order, from the selected one (or the first). Stops that would need a teleport, or are past your camera restrictions, are skipped. Esc or walking ends the tour.

button.name: go_stop
button.label: Go to Stop
button.tool_tip: Move the camera to the selected stop

button.name: copy_tour
button.label: Copy Tour
button.tool_tip: Copy this tour as text, with its name, options and each stop's timing and move, to hand out. Paste Tour turns it back into the tour.

button.name: paste_tour
button.label: Paste Tour
button.tool_tip: Add the tour in the clipboard as a new tour.
